title: Welcome to Strawberry Jam
description: Strawberry Jam is a powerful tool for exploring and extending Animal Jam Classic. This tutorial will walk you through the key features.

title: Play Button
description: Click this button to launch Animal Jam Classic. The game will open inside Strawberry Jam, routed through the local proxy so plugins and network tools can interact with it.

title: Network Tab
description: The Network tab shows all packets sent between your game and the Animal Jam servers. You can filter by All, Incoming, or Outgoing. Useful for analyzing game communication and debugging plugins.

title: Plugins Tab
description: Switch to the Plugins tab to see all installed plugins. UI plugins open in separate windows, while Game plugins run in the background and can add slash commands.

title: Command Input
description: Type commands here and press Enter to execute them. Built-in commands include /servers, /end, and /terminate. Plugins can register their own commands. Press Tab for autocomplete.

title: Console Drawer
description: Click or drag this bar to open the console drawer. It shows system messages, plugin output, and command results. The badge shows unread message count.

title: Settings
description: Open Settings to configure themes, connection options, advanced SWF management, and cache clearing. You can also restart the tutorial from here.

title: Theme Selector
description: Click the fruit icon to cycle through themes. Each theme changes the accent color throughout the app. You can also set a custom color in Settings.

title: You're All Set!
description: You've learned the basics of Strawberry Jam! Explore plugins, try commands, and customize your experience. Join the Discord for help and community plugins.
